source.title: Gathering Light
source.description:
<Omarion seems significantly more animated than when you first encountered him.>

Okay <class>, you've got my attention. This metal is extremely unique, and I'd like to experiment with it some more. However, I'll need additional samples of the raw material. Bring me a dozen or so more ingots of this "lightforged" iron. Also, try to learn more about where these weapons are being created. A smith is only as good as his tools and his crafting space, after all.
source.objective: Bring 12 ingots of Lightforged Iron to Master Craftsman Omarion in Naxxramas and discover where the Scarlet Crusade is forging these new weapons.
source.progress: I really wish that I had some Kaja'Cola to go with these chops. Oh, you've never heard of Kaja'Cola? Well, if you ever get a chance to try some, it'll change your life.
source.completion:
These should do nicely. What else did you learn from your trip?

<You tell Omarion about the Radiant Forge that you found within the Scarlet Enclave.>

Very interesting. So there's a light-fueled anvil inside the Scarlet Enclave, and that's where they craft these weapons?

Well, there's nothing for it. I'll need to see it for myself. I guess I'll take a rain check on dying alone in this awful place.
